entry_state: Participating-dividend tax benefits enter the EPS allocation without creating hypothetical ledger entries. Signed residual adjustments prevent counting earlier earnings benefits twice. The argument now turns to a separate consolidation book, dated control findings and conditional group perimeters; percentage ownership alone does not establish control.
exit_state: Consolidation preserves legal books and a separately evidenced control perimeter. Acquisition goodwill, ownership changes retaining control and loss of control require different calculations. Intragroup inventory profit and its supported deferred tax reverse on outside sale. Functional-currency remeasurement differs from group translation, whose OCI is derived from rate timing rather than used as a balancing plug.
findings: The zero-goodwill40investment case and later96purchase/goodwill16 case are explicitly different acquisitions.
Retaining control turns the additional10%purchase into an equity transaction; losing control measures the whole removed business and any retained interest separately.
Inventory elimination keeps seller tax obligations distinct from group profit. Translation OCI11 is derived from opening net assets and profit timing.
